item.title: President Lee: "Review whether teachers face unreasonable burdens regarding field trips" (이 대통령 “체험학습 관련, 교사 불합리한 부담 없는지 검토하라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung ordered on the 30th, "The Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of Education should review whether there are any unreasonable burdens on teachers regarding legal liability and immunity in relation to school field trips." (이재명 대통령이 30일 “학교의 현장 체험학습과 관련해 교사의 법률 책임 및 면책 영역에 있어 불합리한 부담이 없는지 법무부와 교육부가 검토하라”고 지시했다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung said in a briefing after a meeting of senior presidential secretaries chaired by the president at the Blue House, "President Lee instructed to gather opinions from various sectors including teachers, parents, and experts through a public debate process regarding school field trips." This measure comes amid growing controversy over excessive liability being placed on individual teachers for safety accidents during field trips. (강유정 수석대변인은 이날 청와대에서 열린 대통령 주재 수석보좌관회의 뒤 브리핑에서 “이 대통령이 학교 현장 체험학습 관련해 교사, 부모, 전문가 등 각계각층의 의견을 공개적 토론 과정을 통해 수렴하라고 지시했다”고 말했다. 최근 현장 체험학습 중 안전사고와 관련해 교사 개인에게 책임이 과도하게 전가된다는 논란이 커진 데 따른 조처다.)

President Lee said at a cabinet meeting on the 28th, "If you're worried about maggots appearing, you shouldn't remove the soy sauce jar," adding, "Field trips are also important educational activities. If there are problems, they should be corrected, and students should be able to participate through cost support, additional safety personnel, or hiring more staff." In response, the Korean Federation of Teachers' Associations stated in a commentary, "If the structure where individual teachers bear all legal responsibility in case of accidents does not change, normalizing field trips will remain distant." (이 대통령은 지난 28일 국무회의에서 “구더기 생기지 않을까 싶어 장독을 없애면 안 된다”며 “현장 체험학습도 중요한 교육활동인데 문제가 있으면 교정하고 비용 지원이나 안전요원 보강, 인력 추가 채용을 통해 학생들이 실시할 수 있도록 해야 한다”고 말했다. 그러자 한국교원단체총연합회는 논평을 통해 “사고 발생 시 모든 법적 책임을 교사 개인이 짊어져야 하는 구조가 바뀌지 않는다면 체험학습 정상화는 요원할 수밖에 없다”고 말했다.)

item.title: 'Amid 'Hand Shake Shake' Controversy, Ha Jung-woo Says, 'This Is the Reality of Political Negativity' (‘손털기’ 논란에 하정우 “이런 게 현실 정치의 네거티브 실감”)
item.description:
The conservative camp launched a fierce attack on May 30 over Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the June 3 by-election in Busan's Buk-gu District, after he appeared to shake off his hand after a handshake. Candidate Ha countered, calling it "negativity." (6·3 국회의원 보궐선거 부산 북갑 하정우 더불어민주당 후보의 ‘악수 뒤 손 털기’를 두고 보수 진영이 30일 맹공을 퍼부었다. 하 후보는 “네거티브”라고 반박했다.)

Park Min-sik, the People Power Party's preliminary candidate for Buk-gu in Busan, criticized, "That deep-rooted elitism and arrogance toward residents who have cultivated the region for a lifetime, treating them as a 'different class' that can never mix with him, has unconsciously burst out." The controversy erupted after footage spread online of Ha shaking hands with merchants at Gupo Market in Buk-gu, Busan, the previous day, followed by him rubbing his hands together or appearing to shake them off. (박민식 국민의힘 부산 북갑 예비후보는 이날 “평생 지역을 일궈온 주민들을 자신과는 결코 섞일 수 없는 ‘다른 부류’로 대하는 그 뿌리 깊은 선민의식과 오만함이 무의식중에 터져 나온 것”이라고 비판했다. 하 후보는 전날 부산 북구 구포시장 상인들과 악수를 한 뒤 양손을 비비거나 손을 터는 듯한 모습이 온라인상에 퍼져나가면서 입길에 올랐다.)

Kim Jae-won, a supreme council member of the same party, also fiercely condemned the act during a party supreme council meeting, saying, "It's a scene of shaking off his hand as if it had been dirtied by some filth" and "Former Senior Secretary Ha treats voters like insects." (같은 당 김재원 최고위원도 국회 최고위원회의에서 “무슨 오물이라도 묻은 듯이 손을 터는 장면”이라며 “하 전 수석은 유권자를 벌레 취급하는 사람”이라고 맹비난했다.)

Han Dong-hoon, the former People Power Party leader running as an independent in Busan's Buk-gu District, also shared a video on Facebook showing a Democratic Party deputy spokesperson saying, "Ha Jung-woo's hand-shaking incident doesn't affect the overall trend," adding, "Is the Democratic Party thinking that disregarding Buk-gu citizens won't matter in the big picture?" People Power Party lawmaker Park Jeong-hoon, from the pro-Han faction, also wrote on Facebook, "Shaking hands with voters and then shaking off his hand seems to be a habit. Did the Democratic Party pick someone like this on purpose?" (부산 북갑 출마를 선언한 무소속 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표 역시 페이스북에 “북구 시민들을 무시해도 대세에 지장 없다는 것이 민주당의 생각인가”라며 한 민주당 부대변인이 ‘하정우 손 털기는 대세에 지장 없다’고 말하는 영상을 공유했다. 친한(친한동훈)계인 박정훈 국민의힘 의원도 “유권자와 악수하고 손 터는 게 습관인가 보다. (민주당이) 골라도 이런 사람을 골랐나”라고 페이스북에 썼다.)

As the controversy spread, Candidate Ha held a press briefing at the Busan City Council, stating, "This was my first time shaking hands with hundreds to nearly a thousand people in a day," and added, "By the end, my hand was numb, so I think I made an unconscious hand gesture." He continued, "I regret that misunderstandings can happen, but seeing them attack me as if I had some intention makes me realize this is the negativity of real politics." (논란이 확산하자 하 후보는 부산시의회에서 기자간담회를 열어 “하루에 수백∼1천명 가까이 되는 분들과 악수를 처음 해봤다”며 “마지막이 되니 손이 저려서 무의식적으로 손동작을 한 것 같다”고 말했다. 이어 “오해는 하실 수 있다는 점에서 유감스럽게 생각하지만, (제가) 어떤 의도를 가졌다고 공격하는 걸 보니 이런 게 현실 정치의 네거티브라는 생각이 든다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Candidate Ha paid respects at the Chungnyeol Tower in Busan's Central Park that morning alongside Jeon Jae-soo, the Democratic Party candidate for Busan mayor. This appears to be a move to serve as Jeon's running mate, boosting his own local recognition and aiming to attract votes for both candidates. The Democratic Party officially announced that afternoon that it would strategically nominate Ha for the Buk-gu by-election. (한편, 하 후보는 이날 오전 같은 당 전재수 부산시장 후보와 함께 부산 중앙공원 충혼탑에 참배했다. 전 후보의 러닝메이트 구실을 하며 지역에서 인지도를 끌어올리고, 표심 쌍끌이를 하려는 행보로 보인다. 민주당은 이날 오후 하 전 수석을 북갑 보궐선거에 전략공천한다고 공식 발표했다.)

item.title: Former Chief of Staff Jeong Jin-seok Announces Candidacy for By-Election... Lee Jin-sook Applies for Nomination in Daegu Dalseong (정진석 전 비서실장, 재보선 출마선언…이진숙은 대구 달성 공천신청)
item.description:
Jeong Jin-seok, a former lawmaker of the People Power Party who served as Chief of Staff to former President Yoon Suk Yeol during the December 3 emergency martial law declaration, announced his candidacy on the 30th for the June 3 by-election in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang in South Chungcheong Province. In Daegu Dalseong, where a by-election is being held due to the resignation of Daegu Mayor candidate Choo Kyung-ho from his parliamentary seat, former Korea Communications Commission Chairperson Lee Jin-sook applied for nomination. Amid the People Power Party's candidate shortage, aides of former President Yoon are stepping to the forefront of the election. (12·3 비상계엄 선포 당시 윤석열 전 대통령의 비서실장이던 정진석 전 국민의힘 의원이 30일 6·3 충남 공주·부여·청양 보궐선거 출마를 선언했다. 추경호 대구시장 후보의 의원직 사퇴로 보궐선거가 열리는 대구 달성에는 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장이 공천을 신청했다. 후보 기근을 겪는 국민의힘에서 윤 전 대통령의 측근들이 선거 전면에 등장하는 모양새다.)

Former Chief of Staff Jeong stated on Facebook that day: "In the current state of emergency, I could not turn away from my final duty to rebuild the party and conservatism. I will restore parliamentarism in the National Assembly and straighten out our camp." Regarding former President Yoon's declaration of martial law, he said, "It was a bolt from the blue," but added, "I have not the slightest intention of severing my personal ties (with former President Yoon). I believe no one should force anyone to personally cut ties with former President Yoon. That would be too harsh." ( 정 전 비서실장은 이날 페이스북에 “지금의 비상 상황에서 당과 보수의 재건을 위한 제 마지막 책무를 외면할 수 없었다. 국회에서 의회주의를, 우리 진영을 바로 세우겠다”며 이렇게 밝혔다. 윤 전 대통령의 계엄 선포와 관련해서는 “마른하늘의 날벼락이었다”면서도 “(윤 전 대통령과) 인간적 관계를 끊을 생각은 추호도 없다. 그 누구도 인간적인 절윤(윤 전 대통령과의 절연)까지 강요해서는 안 된다고 생각한다. 그건 너무 가혹한 일”이라고 했다.)

Former Chairperson Lee Jin-sook also applied for nomination in the Daegu Dalseong by-election that day. She has consistently argued for the "principle of presumption of innocence" regarding former President Yoon's insurrection charges, and in an interview with The Hankyoreh on the 22nd, she pushed back by asking, "Are the 'Yoon Again' people criminals?" ( 이진숙 전 위원장도 이날 대구 달성 보궐선거 공천을 신청했다. 윤 전 대통령 내란 혐의에 대해 ‘무죄 추정의 원칙’을 주장해온 그는 지난 22일 한겨레와 한 인터뷰에서 “윤 어게인이 범죄자들이냐”고 반발한 바 있다.)

Additionally, former lawmaker Lee Yong, who served as the head of former President Yoon's executive office during the presidential election process and was called "Yoon Suk Yeol's bodyguard," applied for nomination in the by-election for the Hanam-gap National Assembly seat. He is a figure who has publicly declared his opposition to the impeachment of former President Yoon. In Ulsan Nam-gap, pro-Yoon (pro-Yoon Suk Yeol) figure Kim Tae-gyu, who served as Vice Chairperson of the Korea Communications Commission and now serves as the Ulsan Nam-gap district party committee chairperson, has also completed his nomination application. ( 이 밖에도 대선 과정에서 윤 전 대통령의 수행실장을 맡아 ‘윤석열 호위무사’로 불린 이용 전 의원은 하남갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 공천 신청을 했다. 그는 윤 전 대통령 ‘탄핵 반대’를 공개적으로 밝힌 인물이다. 울산 남갑에는 방송통신위원회 부위원장을 지낸 친윤(친윤석열)계 김태규 울산 남갑 당협위원장이 공천 신청을 마쳤다.)

The party appears to be feeling burdened by this. A lawmaker from the Yeongnam region commented, "This inevitably ties in with local elections, but if the 'Yoon Again' label gets attached in an already unfavorable situation, how are we supposed to run the election?" A party leadership official remarked, "Anyone has the right to run for office, and we can't exactly stop them." ( 당은 부담스러워하는 분위기다. 영남권의 한 의원은 “지방선거랑 연계될 수밖에 없는데 가뜩이나 안 좋은 상황에 ‘윤 어게인’ 딱지까지 붙으면 선거를 어떻게 치르겠단 거냐”고 했다. 당 지도부 관계자는 “누구나 선거에 출마할 권리가 있는데 막을 수도 없지 않으냐”고 했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr ( 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee, a former 'child laborer,' holds Labor Day ceremony at the Blue House with two major labor unions for the first time ever (‘소년공’ 이 대통령, 청와대서 양대노총과 노동절 기념식…역대 처음)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung will host a Labor Day ceremony at the Blue House next month on the 1st, inviting the Federation of Korean Trade Unions (FKTU) and the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions (KCTU). It is the first time the Blue House is holding a Labor Day ceremony. (이재명 대통령이 새달 1일 한국노동조합총연맹(한국노총)과 전국민주노동조합총연맹(민주노총)을 청와대로 초청해 노동절 기념식을 진행한다. 청와대가 노동절 기념식을 개최하는 것은 처음이다.)

The Blue House announced in a press release on the 30th, "President Lee will invite around 120 people, including key figures from labor, management, and government, as well as workers from various occupations and generations, to the Blue House guesthouse for the '2026 Labor Day Ceremony' tomorrow to mark Labor Day, which has been restored after 63 years." (청와대는 “이 대통령은 내일 63년 만에 되찾은 노동절을 맞아 노사정 주요 인사와 다양한 직종·세대의 노동자 등 120여 명을 청와대 영빈관으로 초청해 ‘2026 노동절 기념식’을 갖는다”고 30일 보도자료를 통해 밝혔다.)

They stated, "This is the first time the Blue House is holding a Labor Day ceremony," and added, "President Lee, a former 'child laborer,' will reflect on the meaning of the restored Labor Day, empathize with the value of labor, and express gratitude for the dedication of workers." Previously, President Lee changed the name from 'Workers' Day' to 'Labor Day' and designated it as a statutory public holiday. (이들은 “청와대가 노동절 기념식을 개최하는 건 사상 처음”이라며 “‘소년공 노동자’ 출신인 이 대통령은 다시 찾은 노동절의 의미를 되새기며 노동의 가치에 공감하고 노동자의 헌신에 감사할 예정”이라고 말했다. 앞서 이 대통령은 ‘근로자의 날’ 명칭을 ‘노동절’로 바꾸고 법정 공휴일로 지정했다.)

It is also the first time the FKTU and KCTU are jointly holding a Labor Day event. The Blue House explained, "This was made possible by the labor community's positive response to the Lee Jae-myung administration's state policy direction of realizing respect for labor." (한국노총과 민주노총이 노동절 행사를 함께하는 것 또한 이번이 처음이다. 청와대는 “노동 존중 실현이라는 이재명 정부의 국정 기조에 노동계가 화답해 이뤄졌다”고 설명했다.)

The ceremony will be attended by senior labor figures, key personnel from both major unions, civil servants, teachers, and workers from various occupational groups. Key figures from the business community and civil society will also attend to celebrate the restored Labor Day and honor the value of labor together. (기념식에는 노동계 원로와 양대 노총 주요 인사, 공무원·교원을 비롯해 다양한 직군의 노동자들이 참석한다. 경영계와 시민사회 주요 인사들도 참석해 다시 되찾은 노동절을 축하하고 노동의 가치를 함께 기릴 예정이다.)

The ceremony, running for a total of 50 minutes starting at 9:30 a.m., will include congratulatory addresses from representatives of labor and management, readings of 'labor voices' by various workers such as women, youth, people with disabilities, migrant workers, and freelancers, a presidential commemorative speech, and an awards ceremony for Labor Day merit holders. (오전 9시30분부터 총 50분간 진행될 이번 기념식은 노사 대표의 축사와 여성·청년·장애인·이주노동자·프리랜서 등 다양한 노동자들의 ‘노동의 목소리’ 낭독, 대통령 기념사, 노동절 유공자 포상 전수식 등으로 이어진다.)

There will also be a screening of a commemorative video themed 'Various aspects of labor encountered in my daily life' and a celebratory performance by a choir of non-regular workers. (‘나의 하루에서 마주치는 다양한 노동의 모습’을 주제로 한 기념 영상 시청, 비정규직 노동자 합창단의 축하공연도 진행된다.)

The Blue House stated, "Emphasizing workplace safety, respect for labor, and coexistence and cooperation, we will create genuine growth through labor and a shining Republic of Korea where all working people thrive." (청와대는 “일터의 안전과 노동 존중, 상생·협력을 강조하면서 노동과 함께하는 진짜 성장, 일하는 모든 사람이 빛나는 대한민국을 만들겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government to Hold 12 Officials Accountable for Mishandling Remains in 'Jeju Air Disaster' (정부, ‘제주항공 참사’ 유해 부실 수습 공무원 12명 문책키로)
item.description:
The ‘12·29 Jeju Air Passenger Jet Disaster’ has revealed a systemic failure in the recovery of victims’ remains. Due to inadequate on-site command by fire and police authorities, the initial recovery was poorly executed, and the Aviation and Railway Accident Investigation Board (ARAIB) was found to have left debris containing remains on a road at Muan International Airport in South Jeolla Province for over a year. The government has decided to demand accountability from 12 public officials for their negligent handling and prolonged neglect of the victims’ remains. <<> The Government Joint Public Service Inspection Team under the Office for Government Policy Coordination announced these findings on the 30th at the Seoul Government Complex, presenting the results of an investigation into the mishandling of remains from the December 29 passenger jet disaster. <<> The inspection team stated that the South Jeolla Fire Service Headquarters, which oversaw the initial search, ended the first search despite the continued discovery of remains at the accident site. Furthermore, the South Jeolla Provincial Police Agency, responsible for the second search, failed to consider the need for additional searches even after learning of the discovery of remains the day after the search concluded. The ARAIB stored debris potentially containing remains in ton-bag sacks on an asphalt road at Muan Airport for 14 months. <<> On December 29, 2024, Jeju Air flight 7C 2216, departing from Bangkok, Thailand, attempted a belly landing on the runway at Muan International Airport but collided with a concrete embankment and exploded, killing all 179 people on board. After additional remains were discovered during debris cleanup that began in February, sparking controversy over the inadequate recovery, the government conducted a re-search for victims’ remains in the Muan International Airport area starting on the 13th of last month. President Lee Jae-myung ordered on March 12, “Hold the responsible parties strictly accountable.” <<> Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (‘12·29 제주항공 여객기 참사’ 희생자 유해 수습 과정에 총체적 부실이 있었던 것으로 드러났다. 소방·경찰의 미흡한 현장 지휘로 초기 수습이 허술하게 이뤄졌고, 항공·철도조사위원회(항철위)는 유해가 포함된 잔해물을 1년 넘게 전남 무안공항 도로 위에 방치한 사실이 확인됐다. 정부는 참사 희상자들의 유해를 부실 수습하고 장기 방치한 책임을 물어 공무원 12명에 대한 문책을 요구하기로 했다. )

item.title: Even Indictment Withdrawal Possible… Democratic Party Proposes 'Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act' (결국 공소 취소도 가능하게…민주, ‘조작기소 특검법’ 발의)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea introduced the 'Special Counsel Act for Investigating the Truth Behind the Yoon Suk Yeol Administration's Fabricated Indictments' (Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act) on the 30th. (더불어민주당이 ‘윤석열 정권 조작기소 진상규명 특검법안’(조작기소 특검법)을 30일 발의했다.)

Acting Floor Leader Cheon Jun-ho announced that the Democratic Party submitted the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act to the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee that day. Acting Floor Leader Cheon stated, "Believing that we must thoroughly uncover the truth behind the process by which the Yoon Suk Yeol administration engaged in forced and fabricated indictments, we established and operated a 'Special Committee on National Audit to Investigate the Truth Behind the Allegations of Political Prosecution and Fabricated Indictments by the Yoon Suk Yeol Administration' (Special National Audit Committee). We have proposed this Special Counsel Act to properly confirm the various facts revealed during the national audit investigation through a formal investigation." (민주당은 이날 국회 의안과에 조작기소 특검법을 제출했다고 천준호 원내대표 직무대행이 밝혔다. 천 직무대행은 “윤석열 정권이 억지 기소, 조작 기소를 했던 과정의 진상을 제대로 밝혀야 한다는 생각으로 저희가 ‘윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소 의혹 사건 진상규명 국정조사특별위원회’(국조특위)를 만들어 진행해왔고, 국정조사 과정에서 밝혀진 여러 사실을 제대로 수사로 확정하기 위해 특검법을 발의하게 됐다”고 말했다.)

The targets of the investigation under the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act include illegal acts committed by the prosecution in the process of investigating and prosecuting seven cases: △ the Daejang-dong development preferential treatment case, △ the Wirye New Town development corruption case, △ the Ssangbangwool remittance to North Korea case, △ the allegations of political funds received by former Democratic Research Institute Vice Director Kim Yong, △ the allegations of manipulation of real estate statistics, △ the shooting death of a West Sea public official, and △ the defamation of former President Yoon Suk Yeol related to reports of covering up the Busan Savings Bank investigation. (조작기소 특검법의 수사 대상은 △대장동 개발 특혜 사건 △위례신도시 개발 비리 사건 △쌍방울 대북송금 사건 △김용 전 민주연구원 부원장 정치자금 수수 의혹 사건 △부동산 통계 조작 의혹 사건 △서해 공무원 피격 사건 △부산저축은행 수사 무마 보도 관련 윤석열 전 대통령 명예훼손 등 7개 사건을 수사·기소하는 과정에서 검찰이 저지른 불법 행위다.)

The special counsel is also granted the authority to withdraw indictments in the relevant cases. Lawmaker Lee Geon-tae of the Democratic Party, a member of the Special National Audit Committee, explained, "It's the same method as the Special Counsel Act for the Marine Corporal Chae case. An independent special counsel will make the judgment (on whether to withdraw the indictment)." (해당 사건들의 공소를 취소할 권한도 특검에 부여됐다. 국조특위 위원인 이건태 민주당 의원은 “채 해병 특검법과 같은 방식”이라며 “독립된 특검이 (공소 취소 여부를) 판단할 것”이라고 설명했다.)

Acting Floor Leader Cheon stated, "We will discuss with the opposition party and negotiate a schedule to process the Special Counsel Act as quickly as possible, within May." (천 직무대행은 “야당과 논의를 거쳐 가급적 신속하게 5월 중 특검법을 처리하는 일정으로 협의할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: “Need for Solidarity to Build a World for Both Workers and All Citizens” (이 대통령 “노동자·국민 모두 함께할 세상 만들 연대 의식 필요”)
item.description:
On April 30, a day before Labor Day, President Lee Jae-myung stated, “If some organized workers make excessive or unfair demands just to save themselves, drawing criticism from our citizens, it harms not only that particular union but also other workers.” This appears to be a reference to the Samsung Electronics union, which has announced a general strike demanding the abolition of the cap on performance-based bonuses. (이재명 대통령이 노동절을 하루 앞둔 30일 “일부 조직노동자들이 자신들만 살겠다고 과도한 요구, 부당한 요구를 해서 우리 국민들로부터 지탄을 받게 되면 해당 노조뿐만 아니라 다른 노동자들에게 피해를 입히게 된다”고 말했다. 성과급 상한제 폐지를 주장하며 총파업을 예고한 삼성전자 노조를 언급한 것으로 보인다.)

At a meeting of senior secretaries held at the presidential office, President Lee said, “The power of workers comes from solidarity with other workers who share the same position.” He added, “It’s not about ‘saving only myself’; we also need a sense of responsibility and solidarity to create a world where all workers and all citizens can thrive together.” Presidential spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong reported that President Lee stated, “For excessive demands by some, we must foster a world where we live together with a spirit of empathy and perspective-taking.” (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관회의에서 “노동자들의 힘은 같은 입장을 가진 다른 노동자들과의 연대에서 나온다”며 “‘나만 살자’가 아니고 노동자 모두가 또 국민 모두가 함께할 수 있는 세상을 만들기 위해 책임 의식과 연대 의식도 필요하다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “‘일부의 과한 요구에 대해 역지사지 정신으로 함께 사는 세상을 만들어야 한다’고 말했다”고 강유정 청와대 대변인이 전했다.)

The Samsung Electronics union’s joint struggle headquarters claimed they are receiving less compensation compared to SK Hynix and threatened to hold a general strike from May 21 to June 7 if their demands are not met. When asked by reporters whether President Lee’s remarks were directed at the Samsung Electronics union, a presidential office official responded, “No specific company-related issues were discussed. Please understand it as a fundamental and principled statement that co-prosperity and cooperation among workers, employers, and all citizens are important.” (삼성전자 노조 공동투쟁본부는 에스케이(SK)하이닉스와 견줘 적은 보상을 받고 있다며 자신들의 요구가 받아들여지지 않으면 5월21일부터 6월7일까지 총파업을 벌이겠다고 했다. 청와대 관계자는 ‘이 대통령의 발언이 삼성전자 노조를 향한 것이냐’는 기자들의 물음에 “특정 기업과 관련된 사안이 논의된 바는 없다. 다만 노동자, 사용자, 국민 모두 공생·협력이 중요하다는 기본적이고 원칙적인 말씀으로 이해해달라”고 했다.)

President Lee also said, “To build a country where labor is properly respected and treated, it is crucial to narrow the gaps in the labor market,” and instructed, “Strictly punish human rights violations against foreign workers to prevent recurrence.” On May 1, the presidential office will hold the 2026 Labor Day ceremony, attended by President Lee and key labor figures. (이 대통령은 아울러 “노동이 제대로 존중받고 대접받는 나라를 만들려면 노동시장의 격차 완화가 중요하다”며 “외국인 노동자의 인권 침해는 엄정 처벌해 재발하지 않도록 하라”고 지시했다. 청와대는 5월1일 이 대통령과 주요 노동계 인사 등이 참석한 가운데 청와대에서 2026 노동절 기념식을 연다.)

item.title: "Completely Out of Their Minds"…Criticism Floods Over Byun Jin-seok's Candidacy Declaration for the By-election (“단단히 미쳤다”…‘윤석열 비서실장’ 정진석 보선 출마선언에 비판 봇물)
item.description:
Criticism is pouring in from the political circle as Byun Jin-seok, a former People Power Party lawmaker who served as chief of staff to former President Yoon Suk-yeol during the December 3 martial law declaration, announced his candidacy for the Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang by-election. <<> Yoon Kun-young, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, wrote on Facebook on the 30th, "They are truly, utterly insane," adding, "The person they served committed a crime of treason and received a life sentence in the first trial, while a second trial is ongoing. Furthermore, the former first lady Kim Keon-hee's abuse of power has been fully exposed, driving public outrage to the skies." Yoon further criticized, "Not a single person has reflected or asked for forgiveness, yet someone who served as chief of staff is now running for office," questioning, "Do they see no responsibility of their own, only the Gold Badge?" He added, "I didn't expect much political integrity or decency from them, but this doesn't even meet that standard," calling it "a true 'hopeless' case, not even worthy of criticism." <<> Lee Ki-heon, another Democratic Party lawmaker, wrote on Facebook the same day, "The insurrection forces we thought were buried underground are lifting the coffin lid and awakening again," stating, "The goal of the June 3 local elections is the complete exit of Yoon Suk-yeol." <<> Park Su-hyun, a Democratic Party candidate who resigned from the same district to run for South Chungcheong governor, also wrote on Facebook, "Byun Jin-seok's candidacy declaration. It's shocking that this is possible," calling it "no different from Yoon Suk-yeol's in-prison candidacy." <<> Choi Min-hee, a Democratic Party lawmaker, echoed similar sentiments on Facebook, saying, "I was as shocked by Byun Jin-seok's candidacy declaration as if Yoon Suk-yeol himself had declared an in-prison run," adding, "Yoon Again? Disband the Insurrection Party!" <<> Former Chief of Staff Byun formally announced his candidacy on Facebook, stating, "Given the current emergency, I could not ignore my final duty to rebuild the party and conservatism. I will uphold parliamentarism and correct our faction in the National Assembly." Regarding President Yoon's martial law declaration, he described it as "a thunderbolt from a clear sky," but stressed, "I have no intention of severing my human ties with him [former President Yoon]. I believe no one should be forced to cut such personal bonds. That would be too harsh." <<> Meanwhile, on February 24 of this year, the Special Investigation Headquarters for the Third Special Counsel of the National Police Agency forwarded Byun without detention to the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office on charges including damaging electronic records, abuse of authority obstructing rights, and violating the Presidential Records Management Act. Byun is suspected of ordering the reset of all computers at the presidential office immediately after President Yoon's impeachment, aiming to destroy evidence related to the December 3 insurrection incident. <<> Reporter Song Kyeong-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (12·3 비상계엄 선포 당시 윤석열 전 대통령의 비서실장이던 정진석 전 국민의힘 의원이 충남 공주·부여·청양 보궐선거 출마를 선언하자 여권에서 비판이 쏟아지고 있다.)

item.title: Korea-Australia Foreign Ministers Announce 'Joint Statement on Energy Security'; Discuss Defense Industry Cooperation (한-호주 외교장관 ‘에너지 안보 공동성명’ 발표…방산 협력도)
item.description:
South Korea and Australia held a foreign ministers' meeting and agreed to further strengthen cooperation in energy security and the defense industry. The two countries also issued a joint statement on enhancing energy security, including LNG (liquefied natural gas) and diesel. <<> Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul met with Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong on the 30th at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs building, discussing high-level exchanges, economic security, national defense and defense industry, and regional affairs. <<> The two ministers agreed that, amid heightened volatility in the global energy market due to recent developments in the Middle East, it is a time when cooperation between Korea and Australia—which have maintained a complementary energy supply chain relationship—is more crucial than ever. They decided to make multifaceted joint efforts to strengthen the stability and resilience of the global energy resource supply chain. <<> In the 'Korea-Australia Joint Statement on Energy Resource Security,' released ahead of the meeting, the two countries "reaffirmed their commitment to cooperate in strengthening energy resource security, including efforts to maintain a stable, secure, and reliable supply of energy resources such as diesel and other liquid fuels, LNG, and condensate." It also emphasized that "both countries will endeavor to notify and consult with each other to the extent possible in the event of potential supply disruptions." <<> Australia is South Korea's largest LNG supplier and a major supplier of condensate and critical minerals, while South Korea is a major supplier of refined oil and diesel to Australia. Given the bilateral exchange of LNG and petroleum products, the statement aims to promote cooperation for maintaining a stable supply chain. The statement was jointly issued by the two foreign ministers, along with Korea's Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Ahn Duk-geun, and Australia's Minister for Resources Madeleine King and Minister for Climate Change and Energy Chris Bowen. <<> The foreign ministers' meeting specifically discussed ways to strengthen defense industry cooperation. The two ministers assessed that defense cooperation between the two countries is progressing actively, including the establishment of the first overseas production base for a Korean defense company in Australia, and expressed hope to continue deepening future-oriented national defense and defense industry cooperation based on Korea's advanced technology. Hanwha Aerospace has been operating 'H-ACE,' a facility producing self-propelled howitzers and armored vehicles, in Victoria, Australia, since 2024. <<> The two ministers also agreed to consult on common interests through high-level exchanges, including the Korea-Australia Foreign and Defense (2+2) Ministers' Meeting and strategic dialogue this year, which marks the 65th anniversary of bilateral relations and the 5th anniversary of the upgrade to a 'Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.' <<> Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (한국과 오트레일리아(호주)가 외교장관 회담을 열고 에너지 안보와 방위산업 협력 등을 더욱 강화하기로 했다. 양국은 엘엔지(LNG·액화천연가스)와 경유 등 에너지 안보 강화에 대한 공동성명도 발표했다.)

item.title: Cost concerns plus US sanctions risk…Extracting ships stuck in Hormuz for two months proves a mountain to climb (비용에 미 제재 가능성 우려까지…호르무즈 2달 묶인 선박 빼내기 첩첩산중)
item.description:
The government is making all-out diplomatic efforts to extract 26 Korea-related vessels trapped in the Strait of Hormuz, which has been blocked due to the US-Israel-Iran war, but new variables such as the possibility of US sanctions are complicating the situation. (미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁으로 봉쇄된 호르무즈 해협에 갇힌 한국 관련 선박 26척을 빠져나오게 하기 위해 정부가 전방위적으로 외교 노력을 하고 있지만, 미국의 제재 가능성 등 새로운 변수가 등장하면서 상황이 더 복잡해지고 있다.)

According to a diplomatic source on the 30th, Jeong Byeong-ha, a special envoy dispatched to Iran, met with Iranian officials including Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi over the past two weeks, requesting special cooperation for the swift and safe passage of Korea-related ships. The envoy highlighted that South Korean diplomatic missions and companies remained in Iran during the Iran-Iraq war in the 1980s, emphasizing the significant potential for bilateral relations once the Middle East situation stabilizes. Diplomatic sources reported that Iran welcomed the envoy as the first high-ranking foreign official to visit since the outbreak of the war and highly appreciated South Korea's decision to maintain its embassy in Tehran. (30일 외교 소식통에 따르면, 이란에 파견됐던 정병하 외교장관 특사는 지난 2주 동안 아바스 아라그치 이란 외교장관 등 이란 정부와 접촉하면서 한국 관련 선박의 신속하고 안전한 통과를 위해 각별한 협조를 요청했다. 정 특사는 1980년대 이란-이라크 전쟁 당시에도 한국 공관과 기업이 끝까지 남아있던 점 등을 부각하며 앞으로 중동 사태가 안정되면 양국관계의 발전 잠재력이 크다는 점을 강조했다. 이에 대해 이란 쪽도 정 특사가 전쟁 발발 뒤 이란을 방문한 첫 외국 고위급 인사라고 환영하면서 한국이 주이란대사관을 계속 유지하는 것을 높이 평가했다고 외교 소식통들은 전했다.)

The dispatch of the special envoy is seen as an opportunity to strengthen communication channels and cooperation with Iran amid uncertain circumstances, ensuring the safety of local residents, ships, and crew. The government is known to have communicated closely with the US regarding the envoy's activities in Iran. (이번 외교장관 특사 파견은 불확실한 정세 속에서 현지 교민들과 선박, 선원 등의 안전을 위해 대이란 소통 채널과 협력 기반을 다지는 계기였다는 평가가 나온다. 정부는 이란에서의 특사 활동에 대해 미국 쪽과도 긴밀하게 소통한 것으로 알려졌다.)

However, there has been no visible progress on the passage of Korean ships that have been stranded in the Strait of Hormuz for over two months. Iran informed the envoy that passage would require "prior consultation with Iran and use of designated routes." It is understood that Iran is demanding a kind of "service fee" for navigation guidance when using these routes, which lie within Iranian territorial waters. The South Korean government maintains a clear principle that it cannot pay tolls, based on its fundamental stance that "free navigation and safety guarantees for all ships must be ensured." (다만, 호르무즈해협에 두달 넘게 발이 묶인 한국 선박들의 통과에는 아직 가시적 진전이 나오지 않고 있다. 이란 쪽은 정 특사에게 ‘이란과 사전 협의 후 지정된 항로를 통한 통과’가 필요하다고 밝혔다. 이란 영해인 이 항로를 이용할 때 항로 안내 등의 명목으로 일종의 ‘서비스 비용’을 요구하는 것으로 알려졌다. 우리 정부는 “모든 선박의 자유로운 항행과 안전 보장이 이뤄져야 한다”는 기본 입장하에 통행료는 지급할 수 없다는 원칙을 명확하게 유지하고 있다.)

In this context, shipping companies are reportedly deeply concerned about safety issues with the routes proposed by Iran, the situation further complicated by the US "counter-blockade," and the risk of US sanctions if they use the Iranian routes. While the US targets only ships that enter Iranian ports, some shipping companies cannot fully shake fears of becoming targets of US secondary sanctions for complying with Iran's instructions or proposals. Even if Iran suggests a passage through the Strait via designated routes for Korea-related ships, the shipping companies operating the vessels remain worried about these complex variables, creating another layer of difficulty. Previously, a Japanese-owned crude oil carrier exited the Strait on the 29th using a route designated by Iran, but amid Iran's blockade, the US counter-blockade, and US sanctions, each shipping company applies different decision-making criteria. The government says it respects the final decisions of the shipping companies. (이런 상황에서 선사들은 이란이 제시하는 항로에 대한 안전 우려와 미국의 ‘역봉쇄’로 더욱 복잡해진 상황, 이란 항로로 나올 경우 미국의 제재 가능성을 크게 우려하는 것으로 알려졌다. 미국이 제재 대상으로 삼는 것은 이란 항구를 드나든 배로 한정되지만, 일부 선사들은 이란의 지시나 제안에 응했다는 이유로 미국의 2차 제재 대상이 될 가능성에 대한 불안감을 완전히 해소하지 못하고 있는 것이다. 이란이 자국의 지정 항로를 통한 한국 관련 선박의 해협 통과를 제안하더라도 선박을 운영하는 선사들이 이런 복잡한 변수들을 우려하고 있다는 점이 또다른 변수가 되고 있는 셈이다. 앞서, 일본 선사 소유의 원유 운반선 한 척이 지난 29일 이란이 지정한 항로를 이용해 해협을 빠져나왔지만, 이란의 봉쇄와 미국의 역봉쇄, 미국의 제제 속에서 선사마다 판단 기준이 다른 상황이다. 정부는 선사의 최종 판단을 존중한다는 입장이다.)

Separately, regarding foreign media reports that the US has proposed a new international coalition to enable ship navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, a foreign ministry official stated, "As far as we know, there has been no request for participation yet," adding, "It's still in the early stages, so we need to see what the US has in mind." (한편, 미국이 호르무즈해협의 선박 운행을 가능하게 할 새로운 국제 연합체를 각국에 제안했다는 외신 보도와 관련해 외교부 당국자는 “지금까지는 (동참 요청이) 없었던 것으로 안다”며 아직 초기 단계여서 미국이 어떤 생각을 가졌는지 살펴봐야 한다”고 말했다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Correspondent minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Special Committee on Manipulated Indictments files charges against 31, including prosecutor Park Sang-yong, for refusing to testify under oath (조작기소 국조특위, ‘선서 거부’ 박상용 검사 등 31명 고발)
item.description:
The National Assembly's Special Committee on the Parliamentary Investigation into the Alleged Manipulated Indictments by the Political Prosecution of the Yoon Suk-yeol Administration effectively concluded its activities on the 30th. Led by the Democratic Party of Korea, the special committee decided to file charges against 31 individuals, including prosecutor Park Sang-yong, who is in charge of the 'Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case,' for violating the Act on Testimony and Appraisal before the National Assembly. (국회 ‘윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소 의혹 사건 진상규명 국정조사 특별위원회’(국조특위)가 30일 활동을 사실상 마무리했다. 국조특위는 더불어민주당 주도로 ‘쌍방울 대북송금 사건’ 담당 검사인 박상용 검사를 포함해 31명을 국회증언감정법 위반 혐의로 고발하기로 했다.)

The special committee (chaired by Seo Young-kyo) held a plenary session on that day, adopting the parliamentary investigation results report led by the Democratic Party and passing a motion to file charges against 31 witnesses for violating the Act on Testimony and Appraisal before the National Assembly. The targets include 22 for perjury, refusal to be sworn in, and refusal to testify, and 9 for non-attendance and refusal to comply with an order to accompany. Regarding prosecutor Park Sang-yong, the committee stated, "Without justifiable reason, he refused to be sworn in as a witness at the parliamentary investigation hearing and, despite being requested by the chairperson to remain on standby at the scene, ignored it and left without permission, thereby undermining the authority of the National Assembly." (국조특위(서영교 위원장)는 이날 전체회의를 열어, 민주당 주도로 국정조사 결과 보고서를 채택하고 증인 31명을 국회증언감정법 위반 혐의로 고발하는 건을 의결했다. 위증·선서거부·증언거부 22명, 불출석·동행명령거부 9명이 대상이다. 국조특위는 박상용 검사에 대해 “정당한 이유 없이 국정조사 청문회에 증인선서를 거부하고 위원장으로부터 현장 대기를 요구받았음에도 이를 무시하고 무단이탈해 국회의 권위를 훼손했다”고 했다.)

Additionally, former Ssangbangwool Vice Chairman Bang Yong-chul, who testified that "North Korean agent Ri Ho-nam was present in the Philippines where the Asia-Pacific Peace International Conference was held," and former Ssangbangwool Chairman Kim Seong-tae, who testified that he did not drink at the so-called 'salmon drinking party' cited as circumstantial evidence of prosecution leniency, were also placed on the list for perjury charges. Perjury charges were also applied to former Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office Chief Song Kyung-ho (now a lawyer), and prosecutors Eom Hee-joon and Kang Baek-shin, who participated in the Daejang-dong case investigation. Former National Intelligence Service Director Kim Kyu-hyun and former Deputy National Security Advisor Kim Tae-hyo were also included in the charges related to the West Sea shooting incident. (또 ‘아·태 평화 국제대회가 열린 필리핀에 북한 공작원 리호남이 있었다’는 취지로 진술한 방용철 전 쌍방울 부회장과, 검찰 회유 정황으로 거론되는 이른바 ‘연어 술파티’와 관련해 술을 먹지 않았다고 진술한 김성태 전 쌍방울 회장도 위증 혐의로 명단에 올렸다. 대장동 사건 수사에 참여한 전 서울중앙지검장 송경호 변호사, 엄희준·강백신 검사에게도 위증 혐의를 적용했다. 서해 피격 사건 관련해 김규현 전 국가정보원장, 김태효 전 국가안보실 1차장 등도 고발 대상에 포함됐다.)

Lawmakers from the People Power Party, who are members of the special committee, argued that the adoption of the results report and the filing of charges against witnesses were aimed at "building a case for a special counsel" to erase President Lee Jae-myung's legal risks. They opposed the moves, refusing to participate in the vote and walking out. People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won said, "This has become a committee for solidifying guilt, not a committee for erasing President Lee Jae-myung's crimes." The People Power Party decided to separately file charges against four individuals, including former Gyeonggi Province Vice Governor for Peace Lee Hwa-young, for perjury. (국조특위 소속 국민의힘 의원들은 이재명 대통령의 사법 리스크를 지우기 위한 ‘특검 명분 쌓기’라며 결과 보고서 채택과 증인 고발을 반대하며 표결에 참여하지 않고 퇴장했다. 나경원 국민의힘 의원은 “이재명 대통령 죄 지우기 특위가 아니라 죄 굳히기 특위가 되고 말았다”고 했다. 국민의힘은 이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사 등 4명을 위증 혐의로 별도 고발하기로 했다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Remains Found the Day After Second Search Ended…‘Jeju Air Disaster’: No Follow-Up Investigation Conducted (2차 수색 종료 다음날도 유해 나왔는데…‘제주항공 참사’, 후속조사 안 했다)
item.description:
The process of recovering the remains of victims from the ‘December 29 Jeju Air Passenger Jet Disaster’ has been revealed to have been comprehensively flawed. Due to inadequate on-site command by fire and police authorities, initial recovery efforts were sloppy, and it was confirmed that the Aviation and Railway Accident Investigation Board (ARAIB) left debris containing human remains abandoned on a road at Muan International Airport in South Jeolla Province for over a year. The government has decided to demand disciplinary action against 12 public officials for the negligent recovery and prolonged abandonment of the disaster victims’ remains. (‘12·29 제주항공 여객기 참사’ 희생자 유해 수습 과정에 총체적 부실이 있었던 것으로 드러났다. 소방·경찰의 미흡한 현장 지휘로 초기 수습이 허술하게 이뤄졌고, 항공·철도사고조사위원회(항철위)는 유해가 포함된 잔해물을 1년 넘게 전남 무안공항 도로 위에 방치한 사실이 확인됐다. 정부는 참사 희생자들의 유해를 부실 수습하고 장기 방치한 책임을 물어 공무원 12명에 대한 문책을 요구하기로 했다.)

The government’s Joint Public Service Inspection Team, under the Office for Government Policy Coordination, announced these findings on the 30th at the Government Seoul Complex in Jongno-gu, Seoul, after presenting the results of its inspection into the circumstances of the deficient recovery of remains from the December 29 passenger jet disaster. The inspection team conducted a focused review over one month starting March 23, covering the ARAIB, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the South Jeolla Provincial Police Agency, the National Fire Agency, the South Jeolla Provincial Fire Headquarters, the 31st Division, and the 11th Airborne Brigade. It confirmed that, in the absence of specific guidelines in the National Fire Agency’s operational manual—the agency responsible for overall coordination of aircraft accident search and rescue—the fire department and police set search zones arbitrarily without reasonable standards and proceeded with operations. Deputy Minister for Government Policy Coordination Kim Young-soo pointed out during a briefing that day, “In the process of deploying a large number of inexperienced personnel, there was no relevant training or issuance of specific directives.” (국무조정실 소속 정부합동 공직복무점검단은 30일 서울 종로구 정부서울청사에서 12·29 여객기 참사 희생자 유해 부실 수습 경위 점검 결과를 발표하며 이렇게 발표했다. 점검단은 지난 3월23일부터 한달 동안 항철위, 국토교통부, 전남경찰청, 소방청, 전남소방본부, 31사단, 11공수여단 등을 집중 점검해 항공기 사고 수색·구조 총괄기관인 소방청 업무 매뉴얼에 관련된 구체적인 지침이 없는 상황에서 소방과 경찰이 합리적 기준 없이 임의로 수색 구역을 설정해 작업을 진행한 것을 확인했다. 김영수 국무1차장은 이날 브리핑에서 “경험 없는 인력이 다수 투입되는 과정에서 관련 교육이나 구체적인 지침 시달도 없었다”고 지적했다.)

The decision to end the search was hasty. The initial search for remains was conducted in two phases: the first by the South Jeolla Provincial Fire Headquarters from December 29, 2024, to January 7 last year, and the second by the South Jeolla Provincial Police Agency from January 9 to 15 last year, following requests from the bereaved families. Although remains continued to be discovered, the South Jeolla Fire Headquarters hastily concluded the search nine days after the accident. Even the day after the second search ended, additional remains were found, but the South Jeolla Police Agency did not consider a follow-up search. (수색 종료 결정은 성급했다. 사고 초기 유해 수색은 2024년 12월29일부터 지난해 1월7일까지 진행된 전남소방본부의 1차 수색, 유족들의 요청에 따라 지난해 1월9일부터 15일까지 진행된 전남경찰청의 2차 수색 등 총 두차례에 걸쳐 진행됐는데, 전남소방본부는 유해가 계속 발견되는데도 불구하고 사고 발생 9일 뒤 수색을 성급히 마무리했다. 2차 수색 종료 다음날에도 유해가 추가 발견됐으나, 전남경찰청은 후속 수색을 검토하지 않았다.)

In particular, remains were not recovered but instead remained mixed with debris, abandoned for 14 months in a prolonged state, due to the failure of the ARAIB—the entity responsible for managing the storage of aircraft accident debris—to comply with regulations. After the official search operations ended on January 15 last year, the ARAIB collected the debris on the 16th and 17th and transferred it into ton-bag sacks without properly checking whether remains and personal effects were mixed in. Although it was required by the ‘Aircraft Accident and Incident Investigation Manual’ to establish and implement a detailed debris inspection plan, no such follow-up measures were taken. As a result, the debris was left on the asphalt road at Muan Airport—not indoors in a hangar—exposed to rain and snow under only a waterproof tarp and sunshade until March 26 of this year. It was also confirmed that part of the fuselage with an auxiliary power unit remained among the debris. (특히 유해가 수습되지 못한 채 잔해물에 뒤섞여 14개월 동안 장기간 방치된 데는 항공기 사고 현장의 잔해물 보관 관리 주체인 항철위의 규정 미준수가 있었다. 항철위는 지난해 1월15일 공식적인 수색 작업이 종료된 뒤 16~17일 잔해물을 수거해 톤백마대에 옮겨 담았는데 그 과정에서 유해와 유류품이 섞여 들어갔는지 제대로 확인하지 않았다. ‘항공기 사고 및 준사고 조사 매뉴얼’에 따라 잔해 정밀 조사 계획을 수립해 시행해야 했지만 관련 후속 조처도 없었다. 그 결과, 잔해물은 격납고와 같은 실내가 아닌 무안공항 아스팔트 도로 위에 지난 3월26일까지 방수포와 차양막만 덮은 채로 비와 눈을 그대로 맞았다. 잔해물에 보조동력장치가 있는 동체 일부가 남아 있는 것도 확인됐다.)

The inspection team plans to notify the relevant ministries of these findings and demand disciplinary action against a total of 12 individuals: one police officer, one fire official, six from the ARAIB, and four from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. The specific level of discipline will be determined by each ministry’s disciplinary committee. The inspection team added that it will also overhaul related systems, including establishing manuals. (점검단은 이번 조사 결과를 소관 부처에 통보하고 경찰 1명, 소방 1명, 항철위 6명, 국토부 4명 등 총 12명에 대해 문책을 요구할 예정이다. 구체적인 징계 수위는 각 부처 징계위원회를 통해 결정된다. 점검단은 매뉴얼 확립 등 관련 제도도 정비하겠다고 덧붙였다.)

On December 29, 2024, Jeju Air Flight 7C2216, arriving from Bangkok, Thailand, attempted a belly landing on the runway at Muan International Airport, collided with a concrete embankment, and exploded, killing all 179 people on board. As the government initiated debris cleanup in February this year, the discovery of numerous additional remains sparked controversy over negligent recovery. Starting on the 13th of this month, the government conducted a renewed search for the victims’ remains in the Muan International Airport area. President Lee Jae-myung ordered on March 12, “Strictly hold those responsible accountable.” (2024년 12월29일 타이 방콕에서 출발한 제주항공 7C2216편은 무안국제공항 활주로에 동체 착륙을 시도하다가 콘크리트 둔덕과 충돌한 뒤 폭발해 탑승자 179명이 숨졌다. 정부는 지난 2월 시작한 잔해 정리 작업 중 유해 다수가 추가로 발견되면서 부실 수습 논란이 일자, 지난 13일부터 무안국제공항 일대에서 희생자 유해 재수색을 진행했다. 이재명 대통령은 지난 3월12일 “책임 있는 관계자들을 엄중히 문책하라”고 지시했다.)

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party unleashes full-scale attack on Ha Jung-woo's 'hand-wiping', calling it treating voters like bugs: Is the front-runner narrative shaking? [Gongdeok Pocha] (‘하정우 손털기’에 국힘 “유권자 벌레 취급” 총공세…대세론 흔들? [공덕포차])
item.description:
As Ha Jung-woo, former senior presidential secretary for AI and future strategy, is effectively confirmed as the candidate for the Busan Buk-gu Gap National Assembly by-election, attacks from the conservative camp, including the People Power Party, are intensifying. After resigning from his post on the 29th, Ha visited Gupo Market in Busan for the first time, where he was captured shaking hands with merchants and then rubbing his hands together or wiping them. People Power Party Supreme Council Member Kim Jae-won criticized on the 30th, saying, "Former Secretary Ha treats voters like bugs." item.title: President Lee: "Grateful for HMM Headquarters Relocation to Busan... Will Not Spare Government Support" (이 대통령 “HMM 본사 부산 이전에 감사…정부 지원 아끼지 않겠다”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung remarked on the 30th regarding the agreement between labor and management at HMM (formerly Hyundai Merchant Marine), the nation's largest container shipping company, to relocate its headquarters to Busan: "We will spare no necessary support to help HMM establish itself as a global shipping company." (이재명 대통령이 30일 국내 최대 컨테이너 선사인 에이치엠엠(HMM·옛 현대상선) 노사가 본사의 부산 이전을 합의한 데 대해 “에이치엠엠이 세계적 해운기업으로 자리매김할 수 있도록 필요한 지원을 아끼지 않겠다”고 말했다.)

In a post on X (formerly Twitter) that day, President Lee wrote to HMM labor and management: "Both sides have worked hard through difficult negotiations. Above all, I extend my deep gratitude to HMM employees for making a grand decision." (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 글을 올려 에이치엠엠 노사에게 “그동안 어려운 협상을 이어온 노사 양측 모두 고생 많으셨다”며 “무엇보다 대승적 결단을 내려주신 에이치엠엠 임직원 여러분께 깊은 감사를 전한다”고 썼다.)

President Lee continued: "I hope this serves as an opportunity to enhance the competitiveness of our country’s shipping industry and contribute to regional balanced development. I trust you will continue constructive discussions and smoothly complete the relocation process. Thank you." (이 대통령은 이어 “우리나라 해운산업의 경쟁력을 높이고 지역 균형 발전에도 기여하는 계기가 되길 기대한다”며 “건설적 논의를 이어가며 이전 작업을 원활히 마무리해 주시리라 믿는다. 고맙다”고 했다.)

Earlier that day, HMM labor and management reached a sudden agreement on relocating the headquarters to Busan. (앞서 에이치엠엠 노사는 이날 본사 부산 이전에 전격 합의했다.)

Through this labor-management agreement, HMM plans to amend its articles of incorporation regarding the head office location at the extraordinary general shareholders' meeting scheduled for the 8th of next month and finalize legal procedures such as relocation registration. With the Korea Development Bank (35.42%) and the Korea Ocean Business Corporation (35.08%) as HMM’s largest and second-largest shareholders, no variables are expected in the resolution at the extraordinary general shareholders' meeting. (이번 노사 합의로 에이치엠엠은 다음달 8일 개최 예정인 임시주주총회에서 본점 소재지 관련 정관을 변경하고, 이전 등기 등 법적 절차를 마무리할 계획이다. 에이치엠엠의 1, 2대 주주가 산업은행(35.42%)과 한국해양진흥공사(35.08%)라, 임시주주총회 의결에는 변수가 없을 것으로 보인다.)

HMM plans to first relocate the CEO’s office within the year and then negotiate detailed follow-up measures with the union. The office building is set to be constructed at a landmark scale in the Busan Port North Port area. In Seoul, the operation of branch offices in the sales and finance sectors is being considered. (에이치엠엠은 연내 대표이사 집무실을 먼저 이전한 뒤 세부적인 후속 조치를 노조와 교섭할 계획이다. 사옥은 부산항 북항에 랜드마크급 규모로 건립하기로 했다. 서울에는 영업, 금융 부문 지점 형식이 검토된다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Lee Jae-myung's style of cowardly politics," "privatization of justice"... opposition parties sharply criticize 'fabricated indictment special counsel bill' (“이재명식 쫄보정치” “사법 사유화”…야당, ‘조작기소 특검법안’ 거세게 비판)
item.description:
The People Power Party and other opposition parties on the 30th strongly protested against the introduction of the 'fabricated indictment special counsel bill', which includes the special counsel's right to withdraw indictments in cases such as President Lee Jae-myung's Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance scandals, calling it a "self-absolution special counsel for President Lee Jae-myung." <<> People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk posted on Facebook that afternoon after the Democratic Party of Korea proposed the fabricated indictment special counsel bill, criticizing President Lee and the Democratic Party, saying, "(The Democratic Party) is trying to create an absurd special counsel and even grant the right to withdraw indictments. They fear only Lee Jae-myung and have no fear of the people." Floor leader Song Eon-seok also stated, "They don't want to get blood on the president and the Minister of Justice's hands, so they're employing a cowardly 'Lee Jae-myung-style cowardly politics' by using the Democratic Party and the special counsel to eliminate his own trial." <<> Policy Committee Chairman Jung Jeom-sik also remarked, "Even though the prosecution's right to indict and the court's right to adjudicate are strictly separate, designing a system that allows the withdrawal of indictments for specific cases or specific people is a direct violation of the separation of powers principle and a clear unconstitutional attempt that fundamentally undermines judicial independence." <<> Reform Party Supreme Council member Kim Jeong-cheol (Seoul mayoral candidate) commented, "The special counsel system was created to uncover power-related corruption, not to eliminate criminal cases against those in power," adding, "This (special counsel bill) is not prosecutorial reform. It's not judicial reform either. It's the privatization of justice, where the powerful directly design the exit for their own cases." <<> The Fatherland Innovation Party did not issue a separate statement. <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (국민의힘 등 야당은 30일 이재명 대통령의 대장동, 쌍방울 대북송금 사건 등에 대한 특검의 공소취소권을 담은 ‘조작기소 특검법안’ 발의에 대해 “이재명 대통령 셀프면죄 특검”이라며 강하게 반발했다.)

item.title: ‘Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Bill’ Includes Power to Drop Charges… People Power Party Objects as “President Lee’s Self-Pardon” (공소취소권 가진 ‘조작기소 특검법안’…국힘 “이 대통령 셀프사면” 반발)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea proposed the “Special Counsel Act on the Appointment of a Special Prosecutor to Investigate Allegations of Manipulated Investigations and Indictments by the Yoon Suk Yeol Administration’s Prosecution Service, National Intelligence Service, Board of Audit and Inspection, etc.” (Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Bill) on the 30th, aiming to probe the prosecution’s investigation and indictment processes related to President Lee Jae-myung’s cases during the Yoon Suk Yeol government. The bill includes granting the special counsel the authority to dismiss indictments in ongoing trials. The People Power Party criticized it as a “self-pardon.” (더불어민주당이 윤석열 정부 시절 이뤄진 이재명 대통령 관련 사건 등에 대한 검찰의 수사·기소 과정을 수사하는 ‘윤석열 정권 검찰청, 국가정보원, 감사원 등의 조작수사·조작기소 등 의혹의 진상규명을 위한 특별검사 임명 등에 관한 법률안’(조작기소 특검법안)을 30일 발의했다. 법안엔 진행 중인 재판의 공소를 취소할 권한을 특검에 부여하는 내용이 포함됐다. 국민의힘은 ‘셀프 사면’이라고 비판하고 나섰다.)

Chun Jun-ho, acting floor leader of the Democratic Party, held a press conference at the National Assembly that day and stated, “During the past two and a half years, when President Lee was the party leader, the Yoon Suk Yeol prosecution regime mobilized all state power to target President Lee,” and “We proposed this bill to properly investigate and confirm the various facts revealed during the parliamentary investigation into the suspected politicized prosecutorial manipulation by the Yoon administration.” (천준호 민주당 원내대표 직무대행은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “이 대통령이 민주당 대표 시절이던 지난 2년 반 사이에 윤석열 검찰 정권은 국가 공권력을 총동원해 이 대통령 죽이기에 나섰다”며 “(윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소 의혹 사건) 국정조사 과정에서 밝혀진 여러 사실을 제대로 수사를 통해 확정하기 위해” 법안을 발의했다고 말했다.)

The special counsel’s investigation targets 12 cases. These include seven cases from the parliamentary investigation—such as the allegations of corruption in the Daejang-dong development, the Ssangbangwool remittance to North Korea, the receipt of political funds by former Democratic Research Institute Deputy Director Kim Yong, statistical manipulation in real estate, and the shooting of a public official in the West Sea—plus five additional cases, including the Seongnam FC sponsorship allegations and corporate card misuse and breach of trust allegations. (특검의 수사 대상은 12개 사건이다. 국조 대상이던 △대장동 개발 비리 의혹 △쌍방울 대북송금 사건 △김용 전 민주연구원 부원장 정치자금 수수 의혹 △부동산 등 통계 조작 의혹 사건 △서해 공무원 피격 사건 등 7건에 △성남에프시(FC) 후원금 의혹 △법인카드 사용 및 배임 의혹 등 5건이 추가됐다.)

The bill allows the special counsel to file or decide whether to maintain prosecutions for the cases under investigation. This interpretation suggests that a legal basis has been established for the special counsel to drop charges in cases already indicted by the prosecution. The Democratic Party plans to pass the special counsel bill in a plenary session in May after consultations with the opposition. The special counsel would be appointed by President Lee from among one nominee each from the Democratic Party, the People Power Party (as negotiating groups), and the Joguk Innovation Party (the largest non-negotiating group in terms of seats). (법안은 특검이 수사 대상인 사건들에 대해 공소를 제기하거나 공소유지 여부를 결정할 수 있도록 했다. 이에 따라 검찰이 이미 기소한 사건에 대해 특검이 공소취소를 할 근거가 마련됐다는 해석이 나온다. 민주당은 야당과 협의를 거쳐 5월 중 특검법 본회의 의결을 추진한다는 방침이다. 특검은 교섭단체인 민주당과 국민의힘, 비교섭단체 중 의원 수가 가장 많은 조국혁신당이 1명씩 추천하면, 그중 1명을 이 대통령이 임명한다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk objected on Facebook, saying, “It means ‘President Lee Jae-myung’ will appoint a special counsel to handle the dismissal of the indictment of ‘defendant Lee Jae-myung.’” The Supreme Prosecutors’ Office issued a statement expressing concern that “investigating matters that should be confirmed in ongoing trials could unduly influence the independence of the judiciary.” A presidential office official said, “As this is a matter for parliamentary discussion, the presidential office has no particular position.” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 페이스북에 “‘대통령 이재명’이 특검을 임명해서 ‘피고인 이재명’의 공소취소를 맡기겠다는 것”이라고 반발했다. 대검찰청은 입장문을 내어 “진행 중인 재판에서 확인돼야 할 사안에 대한 수사는 재판의 독립성에 부당한 영향을 끼칠 가능성이 있다”고 우려했다. 청와대 관계자는 “국회에서 논의되는 사안으로 청와대는 별다른 입장이 없다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Special counsel law paving the way for President Lee to end 'Daejang-dong and North Korea remittance trials'... Legal circles criticize as "inappropriate" (이 대통령 ‘대장동·대북송금 재판’ 종결 길 터준 특검법…법조계 “부적절” 비판)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) on the 30th suddenly proposed the 'Yoon Seok-yeol regime's prosecutorial manipulation of investigations and indictments special counsel law' (manipulated indictment special counsel bill), which grants the special prosecutor the authority to dismiss charges, and this bill is expected to emerge as a major issue in the June 3 local elections, now about 30 days away. (더불어민주당이 30일 특별검사에게 공소취소 권한을 부여한 ‘윤석열 정권 검찰 조작수사·기소 특검법’(조작기소 특검법안)을 전격 발의함에 따라 이 법안이 30여일 앞으로 다가온 6·3 지방선거 최대 쟁점으로 떠오를 전망이다.)

According to the manipulated indictment special counsel bill proposed that day by 31 DPK lawmakers, including acting floor leader Cheon Jun-ho, the special counsel candidates are to be recommended one each by the negotiating parties—the DPK and the People Power Party—and the largest non-negotiating party, the Rebuilding Korea Party. The president appoints one of these. (천준호 원내대표 직무대행 등 민주당 의원 31명이 참여해 이날 발의한 조작기소 특검법안을 보면 특검 후보는 교섭단체인 민주당과 국민의힘, 비교섭단체 가운데 의원 수가 가장 많은 조국혁신당이 1명씩 추천하도록 했다. 대통령은 이 가운데 1명을 임명한다.)

The special counsel investigation period is 90 days, but can be extended twice by 30 days each at the special counsel's own discretion. Additionally, with presidential approval, it can be extended once more for 30 days, allowing investigations of up to 180 days. The number of prosecutors seconded to the special counsel is set at 30, and other seconded public officials at no more than 170. The DPK has decided to pass the manipulated indictment special counsel bill through the National Assembly in May. (특검 수사 기간은 90일이지만 특검 자체 판단에 따라 30일씩 총 2차례 연장할 수 있다. 여기에 대통령이 승인하면 1회에 한해 30일을 더 연장할 수 있어 최장 180일까지 수사가 가능하다. 특검 파견검사의 수는 30명, 그 외 파견 공무원의 수는 170명 이내로 정했다. 민주당은 5월 중 조작기소 특검법안을 국회에서 통과시키기로 했다.)

The scope of the special counsel investigation includes the seven cases previously subject to a parliamentary investigation: △the Daejang-dong development corruption scandal, △the Wirye New Town development corruption scandal, and adds five more: △the Seongnam FC advertising and sponsorship third-party bribery scandal, △the Gyeonggi Governor Lee Jae-myung's use of Gyeonggi Province corporate card and breach of trust scandal, bringing the total to 12 cases. (특검 수사 대상은 기존 국정조사 대상이었던 △대장동 개발 비리 의혹 사건 △위례신도시 개발 비리 의혹 사건 등 7개 사건에 △성남에프시(FC) 광고 및 후원 관련 제삼자 뇌물 의혹 사건 △이재명 경기도지사 경기도 법인카드 사용 및 배임 의혹 사건 등 5개가 추가돼 12개다.)

Park Seong-joon, a lawmaker and the ruling party's secretary on the special parliamentary investigation committee, said, "They mobilized over 1,000 investigators to comb through the family, associates, and friends of the then-opposition leader (Lee Jae-myung) to the bone," adding, "It is absolutely necessary to correct the manipulation through a special counsel." Kim Hyeon-jeong, the party's deputy spokesperson for floor strategy, said, "The president shouldn't receive special favors, but it also doesn't align with the spirit of the constitution for the president to bear the damage just because he is the president." (국정조사 특별위원회 여당 간사인 박성준 의원은 “(이재명 당시) 야당 대표를 1천명이 넘는 수사 인력을 동원해 가족, 주변인, 친구들까지 탈탈 털었다”며 “특검을 통해 조작을 바로잡는 게 반드시 필요하다”고 말했다. 김현정 원내대변인도 “대통령이라고 특혜를 받아선 안 되지만, 대통령이기에 피해를 감수하는 것도 헌법 정신에 맞지 않다”고 말했다.)

The core of the manipulated indictment special counsel bill proposed by the DPK is the special prosecutor's authority to dismiss charges. Charge dismissal is a system that allows a prosecutor to withdraw an indictment before the first trial verdict. The bill does not explicitly state a direct authority to dismiss charges. However, it includes a provision that the special counsel takes over the cases from the prosecution that are under the special counsel's investigation and decides 'whether to maintain the indictment.' This effectively means the special counsel could dismiss charges in cases related to President Lee Jae-myung, such as the Daejang-dong development corruption scandal or the Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case, which are currently under trial suspension. In the past, the DPK included a charge-dismissal clause in the Special Counsel Law for the Death of Marine Corporal Chae, but after former Marine Corps investigation chief Park Jeong-hoon was acquitted, the special counsel withdrew the appeal instead of using the charge-dismissal authority. (민주당이 발의한 조작기소 특검법안의 핵심은 특별검사의 공소취소권이다. 공소취소는 검사가 제기한 공소를 1심 판결 전까지 철회할 수 있도록 한 제도다. 법안은 직접적인 공소취소 권한을 명시하지 않았다. 그러나 특검이 특검의 수사 대상이 된 검찰의 사건을 넘겨받아 ‘공소유지 여부’를 결정한다는 내용이 담겨 있다. 특검이 대장동 개발 비리 의혹 사건이나 쌍방울 대북송금 사건 등 현재 재판이 중단된 이재명 대통령 관련 사건에 대한 공소를 취소할 수 있는 셈이다. 과거 민주당은 해병대 채 상병 특검법에 공소취소 조항을 넣었지만, 박정훈 전 해병대 수사단장이 무죄를 받으면서 특검이 공소취소권을 사용하는 대신 항소를 취하했다.)

However, criticism has been raised that allowing a special counsel appointed by the president to make a new judgment on maintaining charges in cases related to the president is unfair. A lawyer who participated in three past special counsel investigations said, "It is inappropriate in many respects for a special counsel appointed by the president to have the authority to dismiss charges in the president's own case," adding, "If a special prosecutor actually dismisses charges in the president's case, who would consider that a fair and objective judgment?" (그러나 대통령이 임명한 특검이 대통령 관련 사건에 대한 공소유지 판단을 새롭게 하도록 한 것은 공정하지 않다는 비판이 제기된다. 과거 3대 특검 수사에 참여했던 한 변호사는 “대통령이 임명하는 특검이 대통령 사건을 공소취소할 권한을 갖는 것은 여러 측면에서 부적절하다”며 “특별검사가 실제 대통령 사건을 공소취소한다면 누가 그것을 공정하고 객관적인 판단이라고 생각하겠느냐”라고 말했다.)

There are also objections that it is inappropriate for the special counsel to take over the authority to maintain the first trial indictment from the prosecution, which indicted President Lee. Yang Hong-seok, a lawyer at Lee Gong Law Firm who serves as an advisor to the prosecution reform advisory group, said, "Assuming unjust prosecution by the prosecution and having the special counsel investigating it also handle the maintenance of the indictment is itself a contradiction." (특검이 이 대통령을 기소한 검찰로부터 1심 공소유지권을 넘겨받는 것이 적절하지 않단 지적도 있다. 검찰개혁자문단 자문위원으로 활동하는 양홍석 법무법인 이공 변호사는 “검찰의 부당한 공소제기를 가정하고 이를 수사하는 특검이 공소유지를 맡는다는 것 자체가 모순”이라고 말했다.)

The DPK's sudden proposal of the special counsel law about 30 days before the local elections appears to stem from the belief that this issue would not be a major election variable. A lawmaker from the Seoul area said, "There might be concerns about provoking conservative voters in Daegu or Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang, but it doesn't seem like it will be a key factor." Another first-term lawmaker from the metropolitan area said, "The parliamentary investigation has revealed the true nature of the political prosecution. This matter and the election are separate issues." (민주당이 지방선거를 30여일 앞두고 전격적으로 특검법을 발의한 것은 이 사안이 선거에 큰 변수가 아니라고 여겼기 때문으로 보인다. 한 서울지역 의원은 “대구나 부울경(부산·울산·경남)의 보수 유권자들을 자극할 우려는 있겠지만 주된 변수가 될 것 같지 않다”고 말했다. 다른 수도권 초선 의원은 “국정조사를 통해 정치검찰의 실체가 드러났다. 이 건과 선거는 별개”라고 말했다.)

However, the People Power Party strongly opposes. (그러나 국민의힘은 강력하게 반발했다.)

Floor leader Choo Kyung-ho said, "This is a cowardly tactic of using the DPK and special counsel to eliminate one's own trial—a typical 'Lee Jae-myung-style scaredy-cat politics'." Lawmaker Na Kyung-won said, "Using state power for one person is also state violence. Looking at President Lee, I think, 'He's a tyrant'." (송언석 원내대표는 “민주당과 특검을 앞장세워 자신의 재판을 없애는 비겁하디비겁한 ‘이재명식 쫄보 정치’”라고 했다. 나경원 의원은 “한 사람을 위한 국가권력 사용도 국가폭력이다. 이 대통령을 보면서 ‘폭군이구나’라는 생각이 든다”고 말했다.)

Choi Ha-yan, Kim Ji-eun, Kim Chae-woon reporters chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 김지은 김채운 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Hyung-joon: "Busan Competes with Global Maritime Cities… Not the Time to Change Drivers" (박형준 “부산, 세계적 해양 도시와 경쟁…운전자 바꿀때 아니다”)
item.description:
"As the slogan goes, Busan is 'now a global city.' We're on a highway to take another leap forward, so we shouldn't change the driver or the navigation system." <<> On the 30th, 34 days before the June 3 local elections, Park Hyung-joon, the People Power Party candidate for Busan mayor, met at a hotel in Yeouido, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, and emphasized, "Busan needs uninterrupted development." Seeking a third term as mayor, he said, "Busan must compete not with Seoul, but with global maritime hub cities like Hong Kong, Singapore, and Dubai," adding, "Developing Busan with those cities as models can also drive balanced growth for South Korea." Park's hair, shaved off on March 23 to call for the passage of a special act on creating Busan as a global hub city, had not yet fully grown back. <<> —You're running for a third term. What are your strengths? <<> "My city management ability. It's crucial to set a clear vision and make it a reality. The administration a mayor handles is comprehensive administration. Experience in doing the job is important." <<> —You've pushed for administrative integration between Busan and South Gyeongsang Province, but it fell through. <<> "Our commitment is strong, as we formed a public discussion committee earlier than other cities and provinces. I was also one of the first to advocate for metropolitan administrative integration during civic movements 30 years ago. However, this integration must be premised on decentralization, not integration without empowerment as seen now. If done this way, as per the roadmap announced last January, we could hold a public referendum on administrative integration this year, enact a related special act next year, and even if my term is shortened, hold elections for the integrated metropolitan government alongside the 2028 general election." <<> —What are your key pledges? <<> "My top pledge is the 'Complex Income, Youth 100 Million Won Project.' Simply put, if a young person works and saves 250,000 won per month for 10 years, the city of Busan will supplement 70 million won through returns from the Busan Future Fund and other sources, helping them accumulate a total of 100 million won. It's a new model where society helps those who make an effort. It differs from the basic income advocated by progressive leftists." <<> —You're trailing behind Jeon Jae-soo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Busan mayor, in approval ratings. <<> "A political month is quite a long time. The atmosphere on the ground is highly competitive." <<> Park recorded 34% in a Korea Research telephone interview survey commissioned by MBC (conducted on the 28th–29th; details available on the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website), while Jeon Jae-soo recorded 48%. <<> —Candidate Jeon criticizes you for failing to secure the Expo bid. <<> "I feel sorry to the citizens. But mega-events like the Expo are rarely won on the first try. It took three attempts to host the PyeongChang Winter Olympics, and the Yeosu Expo was also won on the second try. This is the first time political criticism has poured in after a single failure. As a result, we're losing the chance for a re-challenge." <<> —Will the non-prosecution of Candidate Jeon over suspicions of receiving money from the Unification Church affect the election? <<> "The announcement came the day after he was confirmed as a candidate, coincidentally giving the impression that the issue was swept under the rug through the power of the administration. Most citizens would have perceived it as unfair." <<> —The child of strongly conservative pastor Son Hyun-bo of Segye-ro Church has joined your election campaign committee. <<> "Within the broad tent of conservatism, opinions may differ, but we can join hands anytime toward a common goal. It's a matter of where you set the center, but we shouldn't exclude anyone from the integration." <<> —There are ongoing calls for party leader Jang Dong-hyuk to step down. Will you ask for his support in the election? <<> "Internal conflict within the party leadership doesn't help the election. We should compete based on local government achievements and have high-profile candidates take the lead in the campaign. The election committee should be region-centered rather than central. If the party leadership comes as supporters, I have no reason to turn them away. The leadership has said they'll all attend the opening of the Busan campaign office this weekend, so I've told them to come." <<> Kim Hae-jung and Yoo Young-jae sea@hani.co.kr (“슬로건처럼 부산은 ‘이제 세계 도시다’. 한 단계 더 도약하는 고속도로 위에 있는데 운전사를 바꾸고 내비게이션을 바꾸면 안 된다.”)
